message: There is a big crack on the slope behind my house near Ratnapura and the ground is moving, we are scared.
Water is rising fast on the main road in Kelaniya and it's entering houses right now.
The drain near our street is blocked and overflowing after the rain.
A retaining wall near Kandy town has collapsed and part of the road is damaged.
Someone is digging into the hillside near the river for a new building, looks unsafe.
I noticed a tilted electricity pole and a crack in our wall in Galle, it just started today.
Flood water is spreading near the school and many families live close by in Matara.
There are rocks falling from the hillside close to Badulla, road is partly blocked now.
I want to report a hazard but I'm not sure where exactly, it's near my area.
Culvert near the bridge in Kegalle is broken and the road surface has washed away.
රත්නපුරේ ළඟ බෑවුමේ විශාල ඉරිතලාවක් තියෙනවා, පස් සෙලවෙනවා, දැන්ම සිද්ධ වෙනවා.
කැලණියේ ගං වතුර ඉහළ යනවා, ගෙවල් වලට ජලය එනවා.
களனியில் நீர் மட்டம் வேகமாக உயர்கிறது, வீடுகளில் தண்ணீர் நுழைகிறது.
பதுளையில் மலைச்சரிவு அருகில் வெடிப்பு தெரிகிறது, இப்போது நடக்கிறது.
The bridge near Avissawella looks damaged after yesterday's rain, no one hurt so far.
Just saw some soil sliding onto the road near Nuwara Eliya, cars are stopping.
There is heavy construction cutting into the slope near Kegalle without any barriers.
Reporting a hazard now: the river near Kalutara has overflowed onto the main road.
A large section of the hillside near Ratnapura town is visibly sliding down onto the road, people are running away.
The stormwater drain outside our house in Colombo has been blocked for days, no immediate danger though.
Someone is excavating right next to the riverbank in Kelaniya without any safety barriers, looks illegal.
Just noticed the compound wall next to our house in Kandy has a fresh, widening crack right now.
Heavy flooding near the hospital in Matara, water is still rising and several homes are affected.
I want to submit a report but I don't know the exact place name, it's just near my village.
The culvert under the main road in Hambantota collapsed yesterday after the rain, traffic is diverted.
මාතලේ ළඟ බෑවුමක ගල් වැටෙනවා, මාර්ගය අවහිර වෙලා තියෙන්නේ දැන්.
හම්බන්තොට ප්‍රදේශයේ ගං වතුර වැඩිවෙමින් තිබෙනවා, පාසැලට ළඟින්.
மாத்தளையில் மலைச்சரிவு ஏற்பட்டு சாலை தடைபட்டுள்ளது, இப்போது நடக்கிறது.
அம்பாந்தோட்டையில் வெள்ள நீர் பள்ளிக்கு அருகில் உயர்ந்து வருகிறது.
